## How you checked it

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm assets:validate`, if a picture, a sound or a map changed
- [ ] `pnpm notices --check`, if a dependency changed
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e --project=phone`, if something a child sees or touches changed
